descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads the blind vote over Kimi K3 with a small score edge.
risposta: Gemini 3.8 Flash is ahead of Kimi K3 in the Arena chat score. The difference is 10 points, which translates to about 51% preference in blind votes. Kimi K3 trails by that margin but still scores strongly. The lead counts as a real advantage for Gemini 3.8 Flash.
dimensioni: Gemini 3.8 Flash does not disclose its model size, and its weights are not open. Kimi K3 is 2779.9 B total, with 104.6 B active, and requires about 1686 GB to download in 4-bit format.
velocita: Gemini 3.8 Flash can only be accessed via an online API; it does not fit on any listed home GPU or system. Kimi K3 also does not fit on any of the listed home hardware, meaning both models must be used through a cloud service for generation.
gratisA: Gemini 3.8 Flash can be used for free through Google’s Gemini API free tier. The model is proprietary and cannot be downloaded for local execution.
gratisB: Kimi K3 is available for free download and can be run at home under its own license. No cloud API is required for free use.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash if you prefer a model that already leads in general chat quality and you are comfortable using an online API. It is suitable for users who want quick access without handling large model files.
sceglieB: Choose Kimi K3 when you need a model that excels in coding tasks, as it leads in the WebDev category. It is also the option for those who want full control by running the model locally.

categorie.Chat: In the Chat category Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 1498 versus 1488 for Kimi K3, giving Gemini the edge.
categorie.WebDev (coding): Kimi K3 scores higher in coding, with 1659 points against Gemini 3.8 Flash’s 1584, making Kimi the better choice for development assistance.
